bullets: GitHub 今日 12 个项目中，OpenMontage、daily_stock_analysis、apple/container、hiring-agent 代表四类采用问题：创作流水线、投研自动化、本地容器基础设施和高风险评估 Agent。项目解读已按架构机制、适用团队、落地路径、生产风险、决策问题和观察信号展开。

repo.name: OpenMontage
repo.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skills. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.

analysis.category: Agentic 视频生产 / 多工具创作流水线
analysis.oneLiner: 开源 Agentic 视频生产系统，把脚本、素材、配音、剪辑、字幕、封面和多工具调用组织成可回放流水线；价值在“候选稿生产和失败显性化”，不是跳过创意审核。
analysis.whyItMatters: OpenMontage 把视频创作从一次性提示词推进到生产编排问题：pipeline、tool registry、素材状态、FFmpeg/生成模型适配和人工审稿点都被摆到同一条链路上。对内容团队来说，真正要验证的是每条视频能否降低人工整理、粗剪和版本试错成本。
analysis.engineeringRead: 先读 pipeline 配置、工具注册、素材目录、失败日志、模型密钥和人工审批点，再看演示效果。若团队没有素材授权、品牌审核、终审 owner 和失败归档，技术可跑也不等于可上线。
architectureSignals: 架构机制：12 条生产流水线把素材解析、脚本生成、配音、剪辑、字幕、封面和发布前检查拆成可插拔阶段。
适用团队：增长、品牌、开发者内容、课程和内部培训团队，且已有稳定模板、素材授权和审片 owner。
落地路径：选一类低风险视频模板，只让 Agent 生成 3-5 个候选稿，人工负责取舍、修订和终审。
生产风险：版权、肖像权、品牌一致性、长任务中断、模型费用、错误成片回滚和素材泄露必须先治理。
决策问题：它是在减少素材整理/版本生成成本，还是把创意决策、版权判断和质量责任外包给不可控链路？
观察信号：端到端完成率、人工修改轮次、单条视频成本、素材复用率、审稿通过率和失败可恢复性。
valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「内容团队想把脚本、素材、配音、剪辑、字幕和封面从手工串联变成可回放的候选稿生产线」，calesthio/OpenMontage 的收益应体现为 端到端完成率、人工修改轮次、单条视频成本、素材复用率、审稿通过率 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 素材版权不清、品牌审核薄弱或希望跳过人工终审直接发布，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。
technicalTakeaways: 先抓 先看 pipeline 配置、工具注册、素材目录、失败日志、模型密钥和人工审批点，再决定 spike 范围。
图解字段应突出 12 条生产流水线、工具注册、素材状态管理、Agent skills、FFmpeg/生成模型适配和人工审稿关口 如何把 内容团队想把脚本、素材、配音、剪辑、字幕和封面从手工串联变成可回放的候选稿生产线 转成 缩短素材处理周期、提高版本生成能力，并把创作流程中的失败点显性化。
验收时同时记录正样本、失败样本、成本、延迟和维护 owner。
adoptionRisks: 版权、肖像权、品牌一致性、长任务中断、模型费用和错误成片回滚必须先治理。
与现有 Python / Node 包/前端工程 工具链的耦合要先做最小集成验证。
社区负载相对可控，但仍要关注 breaking change、license 和长期维护信号。
suggestedUseCases: 围绕 Start From A Video You Already Love 做最小 spike，把接入面限定在非核心路径。
用一个可回放样本验证 端到端完成率、人工修改轮次、单条视频成本、素材复用率、审稿通过率，同时记录接入时间、失败样本和回滚步骤。
只在指标改善、维护 owner 明确、风险可隔离后，再从旁路验证扩大到核心流程。
watchSignals: 端到端完成率、人工修改轮次、单条视频成本、素材复用率、审稿通过率、最近 release 质量、issue 响应速度和 Node 包/前端工程 的集成反馈。

deepDive.strategicValue: OpenMontage 最有价值的不是“自动做视频”的口号，而是把内容生产拆成有状态、可观测、可回放的多工具流水线。它适合作为内容工厂/开发者教育团队的流程样本，用来比较人工剪辑、单点生成工具和 Agent 编排三种模式的成本曲线。
implementationPath: 选一个 30-60 秒、版权清晰、模板稳定的内部视频类型，只让系统生成候选稿，不接自动发布。
把素材输入、工具调用、模型费用、失败原因、人工修改轮次和终审意见全部记录成一张复盘表。
只有当候选稿通过率、人工修改时长和单条成本连续两轮改善，并且回滚/终审责任明确后，再扩大到更多模板。
productionConcerns: 版权、肖像权、品牌一致性和素材授权比模型效果更早成为上线门槛。
长任务容易在素材下载、模型调用、FFmpeg 处理和网络 I/O 上失败，必须有断点续跑和失败样本归档。
不要移除人工终审；更合理的目标是减少粗剪、字幕、封面和多版本生成的重复劳动。
decisionQuestions: 内容团队最贵的是剪辑执行、素材整理、脚本创意还是审稿返工？OpenMontage 是否命中最贵环节？
如果只能在低风险模板里提升效率，它应成为内容流水线工具，还是只作为创意原型工具？
谁负责模型费用、素材权限、品牌审核、失败回滚和输出归档？
deepDive.recommendedAction: 做一个受控内容模板 spike：只产候选稿，记录成本和失败，禁止自动发布。

diagram.summary: 素材与脚本进入 Agent pipeline，工具注册层调度生成模型和 FFmpeg，人工审稿关口决定是否进入发布资产库；图解重点展示状态流、失败回滚和权限边界。

repo.name: daily_stock_analysis
repo.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。  LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

analysis.category: LLM 投研工作台 / 多源行情自动化
analysis.oneLiner: LLM 投研日报/看板工具，把行情、新闻、指标、策略解释和推送聚合到一个自动化流程；适合信息整理和复盘，不适合作为自动交易或投资建议引擎。

analysis.engineeringRead: 优先审数据源、缓存/重试、prompt、免责声明、推送配置和历史输出样例；每条结论都应能回到行情、新闻或指标来源。任何自动下单、收益承诺或无来源预测都应视为红线。

生产风险：行情延迟、新闻来源质量、指标口径和 LLM 叙事偏差会共同制造高置信错误。
决策问题：团队需要的是信息聚合和复盘，还是正在错误地寻找自动投顾？

适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 需要合规投顾、自动交易、真实资金风控或机构级数据授权，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。

repo.name: container
repo.description: A tool for creating and running Linux containers using lightweight virtual machines on a Mac. It is written in Swift, and optimized for Apple silicon.

analysis.category: Apple Silicon 容器运行时 / 本地开发基础设施
analysis.oneLiner: Apple 官方容器运行时把 Apple Silicon 上的 Linux 容器体验重新拉回系统级基础设施问题：轻量 VM、OCI 镜像、网络、卷和 macOS 权限边界都需要一起验证。
analysis.whyItMatters: 它不是又一个 Docker 替代口号，而是 Apple 可能把本地 Linux 开发环境从第三方工具栈拉近系统生态。对 Mac 主力团队，真正价值在冷启动、文件 I/O、网络一致性、镜像兼容和企业设备策略能否更稳定。
analysis.engineeringRead: 先用一个非核心 Linux 服务做旁路对比：Docker Desktop/Colima/container 三套环境跑同一镜像、同一 volume、同一网络依赖和同一测试集，记录性能、兼容、回滚与安全策略差异。
architectureSignals: 架构机制：Swift CLI、轻量 Linux VM、OCI image pull/run、虚拟网络、卷挂载、进程生命周期和 macOS 权限边界。
适用团队：Mac 为主力开发机、Linux 服务较多、愿意维护本地开发平台规范的工程组织。
落地路径：先迁一个非核心服务或 CLI 测试环境，旁路对比启动、网络、文件和 CI 镜像兼容。
生产风险：容器兼容性、虚拟网络、文件系统一致性和企业安全策略会决定它能否替代现有本地运行时。
决策问题：团队需要的是更快更轻的本地容器，还是只是在现有 Docker/Colima 流程之外增加第三套差异？
观察信号：冷启动时间、镜像兼容率、文件 I/O、网络连通率、资源占用和开发者回滚时间。
valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「Mac 开发者需要接近 Linux 的容器体验，但又希望利用轻量虚拟机隔离、OCI 镜像和 Apple Silicon 性能」，apple/container 的收益应体现为 冷启动时间、镜像兼容率、文件 I/O、网络连通率、资源占用、开发者回滚时间 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。

analysis.category: 招聘评估 Agent / 简历结构化与公平性解释
analysis.oneLiner: 招聘评估 Agent 把简历解析、GitHub enrichment、岗位 rubric、评分和解释输出串成辅助筛选流程；它最适合做面试官摘要，不应直接决定候选人生死。
analysis.whyItMatters: 招聘是高风险 AI 场景：节省筛简历时间很诱人，但偏见、隐私、解释性和劳动合规会比模型准确率更早成为上线门槛。这个项目值得看，是因为它把 rubric 和解释输出摆到台面上。
analysis.engineeringRead: 先审 rubric、特征来源、GitHub 信号权重、敏感属性处理、解释模板和人工覆写路径；离线回放历史简历时必须按群体误差和候选人申诉风险拆分指标。
architectureSignals: 架构机制：PDF 解析、候选人结构化数据、GitHub enrichment、岗位 rubric、评分模型、解释输出和人工复核队列。
适用团队：有明确岗位能力模型、历史面试反馈和合规 owner 的招聘平台或内部 HR 工具团队。
落地路径：只做历史简历离线回放和面试官辅助摘要，不让 Agent 直接淘汰候选人。
生产风险：招聘评分涉及偏见、劳动合规、候选人隐私和可解释性，必须把 Agent 限定为辅助而非最终决策者。
决策问题：它是在提高信息整理一致性，还是把主观筛选包装成黑盒分数？
观察信号：解析成功率、人工修正率、不同群体误差、面试官一致性、候选人申诉率和合规审查通过率。
valueHypothesis: 如果团队确实存在「招聘团队想把 PDF 简历解析、GitHub 信号、岗位匹配和解释性评分统一成可复核流程」，interviewstreet/hiring-agent 的收益应体现为 解析成功率、人工修正率、不同群体误差、面试官一致性、候选人申诉率、合规审查通过率 的改善。
适合先复制机制、接口或治理方式，不适合未验证成本就全量迁移。
若 缺少公平性评估、想用黑盒分数替代招聘判断或候选人来源高度多样但标注不足，它更适合作为资料样本，而不是生产依赖。
technicalTakeaways: 先抓 先看 rubric、特征来源、GitHub 信号权重、解释模板、敏感属性处理和人工覆写路径，再决定 spike 范围。

验收时同时记录正样本、失败样本、成本、延迟和维护 owner。
adoptionRisks: 招聘评分涉及偏见、劳动合规、候选人隐私和可解释性，必须把 Agent 限定为辅助而非最终决策者。
与现有 Python / Python 包/脚本 工具链的耦合要先做最小集成验证。
社区负载相对可控，但仍要关注 breaking change、license 和长期维护信号。

PDF 解析错误会被后续评分放大，需要人工可修改的候选人结构化档案。
候选人隐私、数据保留、申诉机制和地域劳动合规需要在模型效果前完成。
decisionQuestions: 评分 rubric 是否来自真实岗位能力，还是把历史偏见固化成模型规则？
不同群体的误差、人工覆写率和申诉风险是否被单独统计？
候选人被拒绝时，系统能否给出可解释、可审计、可纠正的依据？

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC 推荐的候选池增长快、内容新鲜度强、长尾供给多；如果召回索引、embedding 和 ranker 分属不同优化目标，离线召回提升常被线上排序、延迟和刷新成本抵消。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 的信号不是“换一个向量库”，而是 index-as-model：把检索索引放进模型化 serving 路径，让候选生成、表征学习、GPU serving、索引刷新和排序目标共用一套可训练、可压测的机制。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 先看 recall@K、候选覆盖率、长尾覆盖、新内容进入率、索引刷新时延、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 利用率、单位千候选成本；线上必须同时验证 CTR/停留/满意度没有牺牲多样性。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴的是组织和平台打法：让召回、排序、特征和 serving owner 共用一张实验表，把“召回质量”和“排序收益”用相同 query/user cohort 回放，而不是单独追求索引吞吐。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、索引刷新低频、GPU serving 经验不足或召回/排序团队目标分裂时，index-as-model 会先制造平台复杂度，收益很可能被维护成本吃掉。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告候选、排序和竞价需要同时控制转化价值、用户体验、延迟与算力成本，单点模型提升很难直接证明业务收益。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户行为序列、实时上下文、候选生成、轻量排序、精排/重排和预算约束拆成可观测阶段，并在高价值候选上投入更重模型。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 优先看 CTR、CVR、CPA/ROAS、广告质量、P95 延迟、推理成本和预算消耗；在线实验要同时观察广告主价值与用户负反馈。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴分阶段候选裁剪、实时特征注入、模型容量自适应和在线/离线差异诊断，把算力预算变成排序策略的一部分。
interpretation.boundary: 流量小、转化回传慢、成本归因不清或缺少在线实验平台时，不适合直接复制大厂多阶段广告架构。

items.title: Using LLMs to amplify human labeling and improve Dash search relevance
items.summary: Dropbox Dash 用少量人工标注和 LLM 辅助标注训练搜索排序模型，解决企业搜索相关性评测与长尾标注稀缺。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索的长尾 query 和权限上下文很难靠少量人工标注覆盖；但直接用 LLM 生成标签又会把 prompt 偏差、权限误召和文档时效性问题带进排序模型。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Dropbox Dash 的路线是“少量可信人工标注 + LLM 扩标 + relevance judge 优化 + 排序模型训练/评估”闭环；DSPy 的价值在于把 judge prompt 从手工调参变成可测目标上的自动优化。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 需要看 NDCG/MRR、人工一致性、judge 与金标相关性、长尾 query 覆盖、权限误召率、标注单价、模型迁移后性能和线上二次搜索率。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合企业知识库/RAG：先建小而准的金标集，再用 LLM 扩大候选标签，并要求每轮 judge 变更都跑回归集和权限反例集。
interpretation.boundary: 没有金标校准、权限模型复杂但不可观测、文档快速过期或业务不能接受误召时，LLM judge 只能做旁路评估，不能直接驱动排序上线。

items.title: PAI-Rec 多路召回截断实践：用 PriorityAdjustCountFilter 和 SnakeFilter 控制精排入口数量
items.summary: 阿里云 PAI-Rec 讨论多路召回后如何用优先级截断和蛇形混排控制进入精排的候选规模，核心是让召回覆盖、业务配额、精排成本和实时性在工程上可配置。

interpretation.businessProblem: 多路召回很容易把精排入口撑爆：热门、个性化、业务扶持、实时兴趣和多样性召回都想占坑，最后要么延迟超预算，要么被粗暴截断损失业务配额。
interpretation.systemMechanism: PAI-Rec 的 PriorityAdjustCountFilter 和 SnakeFilter 把“各路召回进精排多少个”配置化：前者按优先级保量，后者按权重交错，核心是把召回覆盖、业务配额、多样性和精排成本显式化。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 要同时看各召回路保留率、精排候选数、P95 延迟、CTR/CVR/GMV、业务扶持达成率、多样性和新内容曝光；离线 replay 应验证不同截断策略对长尾和新鲜度的影响。
interpretation.borrowable: 中小团队最可借鉴的是把召回截断从硬编码改成可配置策略，并把每一路召回的进入精排率、最终曝光率和业务指标挂到实验面板。
interpretation.boundary: 如果召回质量本身没有分层评估，或业务方配额频繁手工改动，截断配置会变成新的调参黑箱。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: PACMS: Submodular Context Selection as a Pluggable Engine for LLM Agents
items.summary: Conversational and tool-using LLM agents operate over a context window that fills from several directions simultaneously. As a session proceeds, the agent accumulates user and assistant turns, entries drawn from a persistent memory store, and often largest of all, the verbatim outputs of tool calls such as file reads, search results, and API responses. Once the cumulative context exceeds the model's token budget, the framework must decide what to keep. The prevailing mechanism is recency truncation, sometimes paired with periodic summarization. This is topic-blind: a fact established early in a session is discarded simply because it is old, even when the current user query is about exactly that fact; conversely, verbose but irrelevant recent material is retained. Agents that must recall information across many turns, the defining case for memory, are precisely where recency truncation fails. Existing alternatives sit outside the agent's assembly step. Retrieval augmented generation fetches external documents into the prompt but does not arbitrate the agent's \emph{already-present} pooled context. Context-compression methods reduce token count by rewriting or pruning text, but operate query-blind and lossily. Neither treats memory entries, conversation turns, and tool outputs as a single candidate pool to be selected from by relevance at the moment the prompt is assembled.

items.title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
items.summary: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints inherent to fixed-dimensional vectors. An emerging alternative for discrete user representation -- using LLMs to generate text-based user tokens -- captures topical co-occurrences rather than deep sequential behavior dynamics and produces outputs that are difficult to ground to item attributes. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) based item tokenization has proven effective for improving generalization in generative recommendation, yet discrete SID-based representations for users remain largely unexplored. We propose TokenMinds, an industrial-scale system that extends the PLUM framework from item retrieval to user modeling, generating both discrete SID-based user tokens and dense user embeddings via an encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pre-trained LLMs. This dual-output design provides the complementary benefits of discrete, semantically grounded user representations while maintaining compatibility with existing downstream models that rely on dense embeddings. Additionally, the shared SID vocabulary naturally extends to cross-scenario modeling: by unifying long-form and short-form video behaviors into a single model, we substantially reduce training and serving costs. We validate TokenMinds through extensive offline experiments and live launches on multiple YouTube surfaces, served on full user traffic (billions of users) via an asynchronous infrastructure that decouples representation generation from downstream scoring. Focusing on ranking as the primary downstream use case, our results confirm the practical viability of SID-based user tokens at industrial scale and demonstrate that tokens and dense embeddings provide complementary value across different production ranking systems.

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC 推荐的候选池增长快、内容新鲜度强、长尾供给多；如果召回索引、embedding 和 ranker 分属不同优化目标，离线召回提升常被线上排序、延迟和刷新成本抵消。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 的信号不是“换一个向量库”，而是 index-as-model：把检索索引放进模型化 serving 路径，让候选生成、表征学习、GPU serving、索引刷新和排序目标共用一套可训练、可压测的机制。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 先看 recall@K、候选覆盖率、长尾覆盖、新内容进入率、索引刷新时延、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 利用率、单位千候选成本；线上必须同时验证 CTR/停留/满意度没有牺牲多样性。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴的是组织和平台打法：让召回、排序、特征和 serving owner 共用一张实验表，把“召回质量”和“排序收益”用相同 query/user cohort 回放，而不是单独追求索引吞吐。
interpretation.boundary: 物料规模不大、索引刷新低频、GPU serving 经验不足或召回/排序团队目标分裂时，index-as-model 会先制造平台复杂度，收益很可能被维护成本吃掉。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索和社区搜索的长尾查询、权限边界、语义漂移和标注稀缺会拉低相关性，人工标注又难以覆盖全部候选。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 通过混合检索、模型化相关性评估、LLM 辅助标注或自动化 judge，把查询理解、召回、排序和质量评估串成闭环。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告候选、排序和竞价需要同时控制转化价值、用户体验、延迟与算力成本，单点模型提升很难直接证明业务收益。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户行为序列、实时上下文、候选生成、轻量排序、精排/重排和预算约束拆成可观测阶段，并在高价值候选上投入更重模型。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 优先看 CTR、CVR、CPA/ROAS、广告质量、P95 延迟、推理成本和预算消耗；在线实验要同时观察广告主价值与用户负反馈。
interpretation.borrowable: 可借鉴分阶段候选裁剪、实时特征注入、模型容量自适应和在线/离线差异诊断，把算力预算变成排序策略的一部分。
interpretation.boundary: 流量小、转化回传慢、成本归因不清或缺少在线实验平台时，不适合直接复制大厂多阶段广告架构。

items.title: Enhancing Ad Relevance: Integrating Real-Time Context into Sequential Recommender Models
items.summary: Pinterest 将实时上下文接入序列推荐模型，报告转化相关 ROAS 指标提升，适合观察广告实时特征和在线实验闭环。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告相关性被短期上下文强烈影响：用户刚看过的 Pin、当前页面意图和历史序列可能互相冲突；只用离线长序列 embedding 会错过当下转化窗口。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Pinterest 把实时上下文注入 sequential recommender，把候选生成、实时特征、轻量排序和广告质量约束串起来；它的关键是让“刚发生的行为”在毫秒级进入候选和排序，而不是等下一轮离线特征刷新。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 除 CTR/CVR/ROAS 外，应分层看候选 survival rate、ads relevance、候选送达量、负反馈、预算消耗和 P95 延迟；Pinterest 披露的候选相关性和送达量提升只能作为机制信号，仍需本地在线实验复核。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合借鉴实时上下文的特征治理：定义哪些行为能进实时链路、多久过期、如何回放训练，并把广告主价值和用户体验放在同一个实验面板。
interpretation.boundary: 转化回传慢、实时日志不稳定、预算/出价机制不透明或缺少反作弊过滤时，实时上下文会把噪声快速放大到投放决策。

items.title: Using LLMs to amplify human labeling and improve Dash search relevance

interpretation.borrowable: 适合企业知识库/RAG：先建小而准的金标集，再用 LLM 扩大候选标签，并要求每轮 judge 变更都跑回归集和权限反例集。

items.title: PAI-Rec 多路召回截断实践：用 PriorityAdjustCountFilter 和 SnakeFilter 控制精排入口数量
items.summary: 阿里云 PAI-Rec 讨论多路召回后如何用优先级截断和蛇形混排控制进入精排的候选规模，核心是让召回覆盖、业务配额、精排成本和实时性在工程上可配置。

interpretation.businessProblem: 多路召回很容易把精排入口撑爆：热门、个性化、业务扶持、实时兴趣和多样性召回都想占坑，最后要么延迟超预算，要么被粗暴截断损失业务配额。
interpretation.systemMechanism: PAI-Rec 的 PriorityAdjustCountFilter 和 SnakeFilter 把“各路召回进精排多少个”配置化：前者按优先级保量，后者按权重交错，核心是把召回覆盖、业务配额、多样性和精排成本显式化。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 要同时看各召回路保留率、精排候选数、P95 延迟、CTR/CVR/GMV、业务扶持达成率、多样性和新内容曝光；离线 replay 应验证不同截断策略对长尾和新鲜度的影响。
interpretation.borrowable: 中小团队最可借鉴的是把召回截断从硬编码改成可配置策略，并把每一路召回的进入精排率、最终曝光率和业务指标挂到实验面板。
interpretation.boundary: 如果召回质量本身没有分层评估，或业务方配额频繁手工改动，截断配置会变成新的调参黑箱。

items.title: Novelty-Aware Agentic Retrieval: Comparing Research Contributions Through Structured Multi-Step Reasoning
items.summary: Scientific literature search is an information retrieval (IR) task in which ranked lists are insufficient: a researcher entering a new area needs to know not only which papers are relevant, but how they relate, where they overlap, how they differ, and what problem-method combinations are absent. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) summarizes documents independently, discarding this comparative signal. We present the Novelty-Aware Research Agent, a prototype agentic retrieval system that layers structured multi-step reasoning on a RAG pipeline through six typed-contract components: query analysis, a ReAct-style retrieval loop, relevance ranking, schema-guided contribution extraction, a three-pass comparison agent, and answer generation. Beyond returning relevant papers, it produces structured comparison artifacts: per-paper contribution records, paper-level overlaps, and a problem x method gap matrix. On a 100-paper corpus, the system supports five structured comparison capabilities that a standard RAG baseline supports none of, while remaining query-sensitive: across three main queries no paper appears in all three top-5 sets (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.12), and an extended seven-query evaluation holds the pattern across ten queries (mean Jaccard 0.115, 18 of 29 retrieved papers query-exclusive). Under author-assigned graded relevance the ranker attains mean Precision@5 1.000 and nDCG@5 0.752 on the main queries, ahead of BM25, dense, and hybrid retrieval; over ten queries Precision@5 is non-saturated at 0.980 with nDCG@5 0.739. Schema compliance is 86.7% on the main queries and 84.0% over the ten-query set, and validating 20 sampled empty gap-matrix cells yields a gap precision of 0.600. We discuss the latency-structure trade-off in agentic retrieval and identify corpus scale, author-assigned labels, and limited independent evaluation as the main limitations.

items.title: PACMS: Submodular Context Selection as a Pluggable Engine for LLM Agents
items.summary: Conversational and tool-using LLM agents operate over a context window that fills from several directions simultaneously. As a session proceeds, the agent accumulates user and assistant turns, entries drawn from a persistent memory store, and often largest of all, the verbatim outputs of tool calls such as file reads, search results, and API responses. Once the cumulative context exceeds the model's token budget, the framework must decide what to keep. The prevailing mechanism is recency truncation, sometimes paired with periodic summarization. This is topic-blind: a fact established early in a session is discarded simply because it is old, even when the current user query is about exactly that fact; conversely, verbose but irrelevant recent material is retained. Agents that must recall information across many turns, the defining case for memory, are precisely where recency truncation fails. Existing alternatives sit outside the agent's assembly step. Retrieval augmented generation fetches external documents into the prompt but does not arbitrate the agent's \emph{already-present} pooled context. Context-compression methods reduce token count by rewriting or pruning text, but operate query-blind and lossily. Neither treats memory entries, conversation turns, and tool outputs as a single candidate pool to be selected from by relevance at the moment the prompt is assembled.

items.title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
items.summary: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints inherent to fixed-dimensional vectors. An emerging alternative for discrete user representation -- using LLMs to generate text-based user tokens -- captures topical co-occurrences rather than deep sequential behavior dynamics and produces outputs that are difficult to ground to item attributes. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) based item tokenization has proven effective for improving generalization in generative recommendation, yet discrete SID-based representations for users remain largely unexplored. We propose TokenMinds, an industrial-scale system that extends the PLUM framework from item retrieval to user modeling, generating both discrete SID-based user tokens and dense user embeddings via an encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pre-trained LLMs. This dual-output design provides the complementary benefits of discrete, semantically grounded user representations while maintaining compatibility with existing downstream models that rely on dense embeddings. Additionally, the shared SID vocabulary naturally extends to cross-scenario modeling: by unifying long-form and short-form video behaviors into a single model, we substantially reduce training and serving costs. We validate TokenMinds through extensive offline experiments and live launches on multiple YouTube surfaces, served on full user traffic (billions of users) via an asynchronous infrastructure that decouples representation generation from downstream scoring. Focusing on ranking as the primary downstream use case, our results confirm the practical viability of SID-based user tokens at industrial scale and demonstrate that tokens and dense embeddings provide complementary value across different production ranking systems.
